title: chat-message/1.0/message
description: A chat message, optionally a reply to an earlier message in the same conversation.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. These messages are always sent authenticated, so it is always present, and it -- not anything in the body -- says who the message is from.

pthid.description: In a group conversation (group-chat/1.0), the group's id. Absent in a one-to-one conversation.

lang.description: IANA language tag of `content`. SHOULD be present.

content.description: The text of the message. May use Markdown.

id.description: The id of the message referred to. Compared case-insensitively.

author.description: The DID that sent the message referred to, as the referring party knows it.

snippet.description: The start of the referred message's text as it read when the reference was made, or a short label (e.g. "Photo") for a message with no text. Counted in characters.

reply_to.description: The message this one answers. A message reference, usually with a snippet.
